item.title: Issue #2897 created
item.description:
Namespace Axis

I propose that the namespace axis should be supported in XQuery and that we remove its deprecation in XPath.

  1. The current situation leads to a loss of interoperability. It isn't practical to remove the namespace axis from the specs because it is widely used. There is no good reason to deprecate the feature because it is technically sound, so promoting it to a first-class citizen seems the best approach.
  2. It's slightly absurd that XQuery (since 3.0) allows you to construct namespace nodes and attach them to a tree but doesn't allow you to find them on the tree.
  3. It's also slightly absurd that XPath deprecates the namespace axis but XSLT requires implementors to provide it.
  4. This simplifies the data model, which currently skirts around the issue.
  5. The proposed update expression will create additional use cases for namespace nodes. In particular a common requirement is to remove unused namespace nodes and the update expression provides a convenient way to achieve that.
  6. Historically, there were objections to the namespace axis because of implementation concerns. But many products have found efficient ways to implement the namespace axis using transient or "flyweight" nodes, which is presumably the same technique that products will need to use to implement JNodes efficiently.
